thread.title: Markets Now: Dow Dips 32 Points as Trade War Heats Up

author: Ben Levisohn
title: Markets Now: Dow Dips 32 Points as Trade War Heats Up
text:
By Ben Levisohn Aug. 1, 2018 8:05 a.m. ET Want to know why the Dow is doing what it's doing? Check back here for a semi-live look at the volatile markets from Barron's reporters.
Illustration: Getty Images 7:50 a.m. Remember Tuesday's optimism about trade talks with China? Well it's gone this morning after reports President Donald Trump is considering putting tariffs of 25%, not 10%, on $200 billion of Chinese goods . Still, the damage isn't too great. S&P 500 futures are little changed, while Dow futures have dropped 32 points, 0r 0.1%. Nasdaq Composite futures have risen 0.3%.
Credit Apple (AAPL) for providing a market floor. It's gained 4.4% to $198.72 in pre-open trading after reporting better-than-expected earnings . The Federal Reserve is set to release its monetary policy statement this afternoon, so don't be surprised if trading is quiet until then.
